sections.description:
Daily Slider is the ultimate WordPress slider plugin for Elementor page builder that transforms your website with stunning visual elements. Create professional hero sections, testimonial carousels, portfolio galleries, and animated marquee displays with zero coding required.

Perfect for WordPress developers, designers, and business owners who want to build engaging websites that convert visitors into customers. Our slider widgets are mobile-first, SEO-optimized, and performance-focused to ensure fast loading times across all devices.

🎬 Live Demos

See Daily Slider in action! Explore our interactive demos to experience the full potential of each widget:

View All Demos | Pixel Hero Slider | Review Carousel | Eldorado Gallery | Marquee Slider | Testimonials Marquee

Why Choose Daily Slider?

4 Premium Slider Widgets – Hero sliders, testimonial carousels, image galleries, and marquee animations
Mobile-First Design – Fully responsive on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
Performance Optimized – Fast loading with conditional asset loading
SEO Friendly – Clean HTML markup and semantic structure
Easy Customization – Visual controls for colors, typography, spacing, and animations
Professional Templates – Ready-to-use designs for quick implementation
Regular Updates – Compatible with latest WordPress and Elementor versions

Complete Slider Solution for WordPress:

Pixel Hero Slider – Create stunning full-screen hero sections with parallax effects, custom animations, and call-to-action buttons. Perfect for landing pages and homepage headers.

Review Carousel Widget – Showcase customer testimonials and reviews with star ratings, author photos, and social proof elements to boost conversions and build trust.

Eldorado Image Gallery – Display portfolio projects, product galleries, and photography collections with hover effects, lightbox integration, and grid layouts.

Marquee Slider Widget – Create eye-catching scrolling animations for logos, announcements, news tickers, and promotional content with horizontal and vertical scrolling options.

Advanced Customization – Visual style controls for typography, colors, spacing, borders, shadows, and responsive breakpoints without touching code.

Performance Features – Conditional asset loading, lazy loading images, optimized animations, and minimal CSS/JS footprint for faster page speeds.

Perfect for:

  • Business Websites – Showcase services, testimonials, and company achievements
  • Portfolio Sites – Display creative work, projects, and case studies
  • E-commerce Stores – Feature products, customer reviews, and promotional banners
  • Agencies & Freelancers – Create client presentations and service showcases
  • Blogs & Media – Highlight featured content and author testimonials

Get started in minutes with our intuitive drag-and-drop interface and transform your WordPress website into a conversion-focused, professional online presence.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/daily-slider directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Elementor Editor and find the DailySlider widgets under the Elementor Widgets panel.
  4. Drag and drop your desired widget (Pixel, Review Carousel, Eldorado, or Marquee Slider) into your page and start customizing.
sections.faq:
Is Daily Slider compatible with all WordPress themes?

Yes! Daily Slider works with any WordPress theme that supports Elementor page builder. Our widgets are designed to seamlessly integrate with your existing design.

Can I use these slider widgets on mobile devices?

Absolutely! All slider widgets are mobile-first responsive and optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. You can customize layouts for each device breakpoint.

Does this plugin require Elementor Pro?

No, Daily Slider works with the free version of Elementor. However, you need Elementor page builder installed and activated to use our slider widgets.

Will these sliders slow down my website?

No! Our sliders are performance-optimized with conditional asset loading, meaning only the CSS/JS for active widgets will load. This ensures fast page speeds and better SEO rankings.

Can I customize the slider animations and effects?

Yes! The plugin provides extensive customization options including animations, hover effects, transitions, colors, typography, and responsive settings – all through Elementor’s visual interface.

Do you provide customer support?

Yes! We provide comprehensive documentation and support for all Daily Slider features. Check our GitHub repository for updates and community support.

= 2.7.0 [23 January 2026] =

  • Improved: Removed unnecessary code to improve performance and maintainability.

= 2.6.0 [22nd January 2026] =

  • Improved: Widget Manager UI with enhanced layout featuring demo links and better visual organization.
  • Improved: Welcome page dashboard with updated website links pointing to official plugin homepage.
  • Improved: Quick Access section in dashboard with updated links to knowledge base and feature requests.
  • Enhanced: Overall dashboard design with better spacing, alignment, and user-friendly interface improvements.
  • Updated: Plugin homepage and demo URLs to https://xpospark.com/plugin/daily-slider/ for centralized documentation.

= 2.5.0 [19th December 2025] =

  • Added: Testimonials Marquee Widget — brand new dedicated widget for showcasing customer testimonials in a scrolling format.
  • Added: Star rating system with customizable colors and sizes for testimonials display.
  • Added: User profile section with author names, company details, and professional images.
  • Added: Comprehensive styling controls for testimonial cards including background, borders, shadows, and hover effects.
  • Added: Responsive width controls for both individual cards and container with support for px, %, and vw

= 2.3.0 [12th December 2025] =

  • Added: Vertical scrolling option to Marquee Slider widget — now supports both horizontal and vertical scroll directions.
  • Added: Vertical direction control (up/down) for vertical marquee animations.
  • Added: Vertical height control for customizing container height in vertical mode.
  • Enhanced: Marquee Slider edge masking now works for both horizontal and vertical scrolling.
  • Improved: Animation performance and responsiveness for vertical scrolling mode.
  • Updated: JavaScript animation engine to support dynamic axis switching and direction control.

= 2.2.0 [5th December 2025] =

  • Fixed: Early translation loading error — resolved “_load_textdomain_just_in_time was called incorrectly” notice by loading the text domain properly on the init hook according to WordPress 6.7+ standards.
  • Improved: Translation system compatibility with WordPress Core.
  • Enhanced: Code structure for better stability and premium-theme compatibility.

= 2.1.0 [5th December 2025] =

  • Added new customization options for all slider widgets
  • Improved performance and loading speed across all widgets
  • Enhanced responsive design for better mobile experience
  • Added new animation effects and transition options
  • Fixed minor bugs and improved overall stability
  • Updated compatibility with latest WordPress and Elementor versions

1.7.0 [27th August 2025]

  • Fixed marquee slider animation glitch on mobile devices
  • Fixed responsive layout issues in Review Carousel widget
  • Fixed compatibility issues with latest WordPress version

1.6.0 [31th January 2025]

  • Added Marquee Slider Widget with smooth scrolling animations, customizable speed, direction, and pause on hover functionality.
  • Enhanced marquee widget with edge masking effects and responsive design.
  • Improved overall plugin stability and performance.

1.5 [31th January 2025]

  • Added hover transform scale effect to Eldorado Widget, for improved image interaction.

1.0.0 [28th January 2025]

  • Initial release of the DailySlider Elementor Plugin with the following widgets:
    • Pixel: Full-screen hero slider
    • Review Carousel: Dynamic testimonial showcase
    • Eldorado: Portfolio and image carousel
    • Marquee Slider: Smooth scrolling marquee effects
